verdict.rationale: Unreal exposes a REST-like Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only human-readable HTML references and no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The locally generated Python autocomplete stub is an IDE aid for editor scripting, not a downloadable API spec, so it is adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
